searchText: tldr from eip-1559 call: general consensus seems to be that eip-2718 makes sense to bundle w/ 1559. Their main concern is its potential to delay 1559. So as long as we can get 2718 accepted and scheduled for a hard fork before or inline with 1559 it should work out I'll introduce 2718 this week at ACD and will update with their initial thoughts i'd also like to know if anyone knows how eip-232 was received and why it was never accepted, as it is very similar to 2718
